title: Training language models in simulation for psychiatric intake
title_zh: 在仿真环境中训练面向精神科接诊的语言模型

paragraphs.en: In psychiatric practice, the clinical intake interview remains a primary diagnostic instrument, requiring the clinician to establish rapport while disentangling complex, overlapping presentations. Here, we show that multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation environments improves language model performance on structured text-based psychiatric intake, spanning history-taking, differential diagnosis, and initial management planning. In a randomized, double-blind crossover study ( N = 60 N{=}60 matched scenario pairs, 120 encounters) comparing the RL-trained agent against its identically prompted base model, 32 board-certified psychiatrists role-played standardized patients while a separate panel of 15 independent, board-certified psychiatrists scored the de-identified transcripts. The trained agent outperformed the base model in 76.7% of matched scenario pairs ( p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), with gains on an adapted clinical-examination rubric ( d z = 0.77 d_{z}=0.77 , p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), patient-centered communication (82.0% vs. 65.2%, p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), and differential diagnosis appropriateness (68.3% vs. 33.3%, p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). Across 127 psychiatrist-validated simulated intake scenarios, the trained agent nearly doubled its base model’s clinical rubric score (0.706 vs. 0.379; composite reward 0.564 vs. 0.294, p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ). To systematically probe conversational safety, we established two Delphi-consensus taxonomies, of clinical safety risks and relational competencies, from which 256 challenging adversarial presentations were derived; we find that training in simulation environments more than halved under-triage of acute safety risks (12.9% vs. 30.5%, p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ). Substantial clinical gaps nonetheless remained, with comprehensive and appropriate treatment recommended in only 46.7% of human-evaluated encounters, at least one critical intake question omitted in 60.6% of simulated intakes, and acute safety risks under-triaged in 12.9% of adversarial presentations. Simulation environments thus provide a controlled testbed for training and stress-testing psychiatric conversational agents, with gains that transferred to psychiatrist-enacted encounters. However, addressing residual diagnostic, management, and safety limitations, alongside integrating external safeguards and clinician-supervised workflows, remains necessary before prospective clinical validation with real patients.
paragraphs.zh: 在精神科临床实践中，临床接诊访谈仍然是最主要的诊断工具，临床医生既需要建立医患信任关系，又需要厘清复杂且相互重叠的症状表现。 在本研究中，我们发现在仿真环境中进行多轮强化学习（RL）可以提升语言模型在结构化文本式精神科接诊任务上的表现，涵盖病史采集、鉴别诊断和初步治疗计划制定。 在一项随机、双盲交叉研究（N{=}60 组匹配情境对，共 120 次接诊）中，我们将经过 RL 训练的智能体与使用完全相同提示词的基础模型进行比较：32 名委员会认证的精神科医生扮演标准化病人，另由 15 名独立的委员会认证精神科医生组成评审小组，对去标识化的访谈记录进行评分。 在 76.7% 的匹配情境对中，训练后的智能体优于基础模型（p<0.0001），其优势体现在改编后的临床考核评分表（d_{z}=0.77，p<0.0001）、以病人为中心的沟通（82.0% vs. 65.2%，p<0.001）以及鉴别诊断的恰当性（68.3% vs. 33.3%，p<0.001）上。 在 127 个经精神科医生验证的模拟接诊情境中，训练后的智能体的临床评分表得分几乎是基础模型的两倍（0.706 vs. 0.379；综合奖励 0.564 vs. 0.294，p<0.0001）。 为系统性地考察对话安全性，我们通过德尔菲共识法建立了临床安全风险和关系能力两套分类体系，并据此设计了 256 个具有挑战性的对抗性病例；我们发现，在仿真环境中的训练使对急性安全风险的分诊不足减少了超过一半（12.9% vs. 30.5%，p<0.0001）。 尽管如此，临床上仍存在显著差距：在人工评估的接诊中，仅 46.7% 给出了全面且恰当的治疗建议；在模拟接诊中，60.6% 至少遗漏了一个关键的问诊问题；在对抗性病例中，12.9% 对急性安全风险分诊不足。 因此，仿真环境为精神科对话智能体的训练和压力测试提供了一个可控的试验平台，其所带来的提升可以迁移到由精神科医生参与的接诊场景中。 然而，在与真实患者开展前瞻性临床验证之前，仍需解决残余的诊断、治疗和安全方面的局限，并整合外部保障机制和由临床医生监督的工作流程。

paragraphs.en: Clinical dialogue is foundational to patient-facing medicine, but in psychiatry, the clinical interview itself remains a principal diagnostic instrument 144 . In psychiatric presentations, the psychopathology itself can directly compromise how history is communicated, and patients often do not recognize the relevance of prior treatment failures or comorbid medical conditions causing their symptoms 25 ; 10 ; 39 . As a result, the quality of the history depends on both systematic inquiry into these complex causes and interpersonal trust, with a stronger therapeutic alliance supporting more complete diagnostic formulation and improved treatment outcomes 149 ; 119 ; 180 . Competent clinical dialogue couples two skill domains, diagnostic reasoning (differential diagnosis, psychopharmacology, risk stratification) and interpersonal processing (reading affect and psychological defenses, crisis de-escalation, shared decision-making, stigma-sensitive communication) 92 ; 2 ; 176 . In psychiatry, both dimensions are especially entangled. A clinician who probes aggressively risks rupturing rapport; one who overprioritizes validation may never arrive at a diagnosis. Here we investigate whether language models can acquire these capabilities through training in simulated clinical environments.
paragraphs.zh: 临床对话是面向患者的医学的基础，而在精神病学中，临床访谈本身仍是一种主要的诊断工具 144 。 在精神科的表现中，精神病理本身可能直接影响病史的表述，患者往往也意识不到既往治疗失败或引起其症状的共病躯体情况的相关性 25 ; 10 ; 39 。 因此，病史的质量既取决于对这些复杂病因的系统性询问，也取决于人际信任，更强的治疗联盟能支持更完整的诊断构建并改善治疗结局 149 ; 119 ; 180 。 胜任的临床对话结合了两个技能领域：诊断推理（鉴别诊断、精神药理学、风险分层）和人际处理（识别情感与心理防御、危机降级、共同决策、顾及病耻感的沟通） 92 ; 2 ; 176 。 在精神病学中，这两个维度尤其相互纠缠。 过于咄咄逼人地探询的临床医生可能破坏融洽关系；而过度侧重于共情的医生可能永远无法得出诊断。 在此，我们研究语言模型能否通过在模拟临床环境中的训练来获得这些能力。

paragraphs.en: Large language models now perform strongly on clinical question-answering 162 ; 163 , clinical reasoning 127 ; 14 ; 109 ; 81 , and conversational diagnosis 176 ; 15 ; 99 , and a growing body of work applies them to mental health 31 ; 166 ; 134 ; 47 , including psychiatric evaluation datasets 128 ; 104 ; 35 , clinician-facing decision support 183 , and patient-facing conversational systems. Evaluations of conversational medical AI have nonetheless largely excluded psychiatric presentations 176 ; 15 ; 99 ; 75 . In the general medical settings those systems target, the conversation gathers a history that physical examination and laboratory testing can subsequently supplement; in psychiatry, where critical history and risk factors often emerge through skilled inquiry, the quality of the conversation itself determines the quality of the diagnostic information obtained 144 ; 55 ; 161 . If eventually validated for clinical use, conversational intake systems may supplement static screening questionnaires in supervised pre-visit workflows by gathering preliminary history, conducting a medical review of systems (i.e., a structured inventory of physical symptoms across organ systems to screen for somatic causes) and medication reconciliation, and organizing a provisional differential diagnosis for the evaluating clinician to review and verify 75 ; 131 .
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型目前在临床问答 162 ; 163 、临床推理 127 ; 14 ; 109 ; 81 以及对话式诊断 176 ; 15 ; 99 方面表现强劲，且越来越多的工作将其应用于心理健康领域 31 ; 166 ; 134 ; 47 ，包括精神科评估数据集 128 ; 104 ; 35 、面向临床医生的决策支持 183 ，以及面向患者的对话系统。 然而，对对话式医疗人工智能的评估在很大程度上排除了精神科主诉 176 ; 15 ; 99 ; 75 。 在这些系统所针对的普通医疗场景中，对话采集病史，随后可由体格检查和实验室检测加以补充；而在精神科，关键病史和风险因素往往需通过熟练的问诊才能显现，对话本身的质量决定了所获诊断信息的质量 144 ; 55 ; 161 。 如果最终能在临床应用中得到验证，对话式接诊系统可在有监督的就诊前工作流程中补充静态筛查问卷，其功能包括采集初步病史、进行系统回顾（即对各器官系统的躯体症状进行结构化清点，以筛查躯体性病因）与用药情况核对，并为接诊医生整理初步鉴别诊断以供其审阅和核实 75 ; 131 。

paragraphs.en: In medical education, clinical competence is developed through structured practice with standardized patients and assessed through Objective Structured Clinical Examinations (OSCEs) 7 ; 61 ; 68 . Psychiatry uses the same instrument to rehearse de-escalation, risk stratification, and rapport building under acute ambiguity 137 ; 67 . Language models can likewise acquire conversational and sequential decision-making capabilities by interacting with simulated clinical environments, with reported generalization to unseen patient profiles, out-of-distribution diagnostic categories, and multi-turn dialogue settings 100 ; 32 ; 41 ; 88 ; 176 , and generative patient simulators increasingly incorporate behavioral phenotypes, biases, and changing emotional states 152 ; 151 ; 86 . Whether these approaches are sufficient to improve conversational psychiatric competence remains untested.
paragraphs.zh: 在医学教育中，临床能力通过标准化病人的结构化练习来培养，并通过客观结构化临床考试（OSCE）进行评估 7 ; 61 ; 68 。 精神病学使用同样的工具来演练急性不确定性情境下的危机降级、风险分层和信任关系建立 137 ; 67 。 语言模型同样可以通过与模拟临床环境交互来获得对话和序贯决策能力，已有研究报道其能够泛化到未见过的患者档案、分布外的诊断类别和多轮对话场景 100 ; 32 ; 41 ; 88 ; 176 ，而且生成式病人模拟器日益纳入行为表型、偏见和不断变化的情绪状态 152 ; 151 ; 86 。 这些方法是否足以提升对话式精神病学能力仍有待验证。

paragraphs.en: Here, we trained a large language model with multi-turn reinforcement learning across simulated psychiatric encounters, optimizing jointly for diagnostic accuracy, patient-centered communication, and clinical safety (Fig. 1 ). To isolate the effect of training, the simulation-trained agent and its base model were prompted and evaluated identically within each evaluation, sharing the same clinical system prompt and structured tools. sents.zh: 在此，我们在模拟精神科问诊中通过多轮强化学习训练了一个大语言模型，同时优化诊断准确性、以患者为中心的沟通以及临床安全性（图 1）。

sents.en: To isolate the effect of training, the simulation-trained agent and its base model were prompted and evaluated identically within each evaluation, sharing the same clinical system prompt and structured tools.
sents.zh: 为了分离训练带来的效应，经模拟训练的智能体与其基座模型在每次评估中均以相同方式进行提示和评估，共享相同的临床系统提示与结构化工具。

sents.en: We validated the resulting agent in three complementary evaluations:
sents.zh: 我们通过三项互补的评估对该智能体进行了验证：

paragraphs.en: Blinded human expert evaluation (Section 2.1 ): To test whether competencies acquired in silico transfer to encounters with human experts, we conducted a randomized, double-blind crossover evaluation ( N = 60 N{=}60 matched scenario pairs, 120 text-based consultations) in which the agent occupied the clinician role, 32 board-certified psychiatrists role-played the patients, and a separate panel of 15 blinded, independent, board-certified psychiatrists scored de-identified transcripts. The trained agent received a higher score than the identically prompted base model in 76.7% of matched scenario pairs ( p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), with gains over the base model on an adapted Practical Assessment of Clinical Examination Skills (PACES) clinical-examination rubric 40 ( d z = 0.77 d_{z}=0.77 , p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), patient-centered communication 108 ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), differential diagnosis appropriateness ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), and management plan appropriateness ( p = 0.018 p=0.018 ).
paragraphs.zh: 盲法人类专家评估（第2.1节）：为检验在计算机仿真环境中获得的能力能否迁移到与人类专家的互动中，我们开展了一项随机、双盲交叉评估（N=60 个匹配场景对，120 次基于文本的问诊），其中智能体扮演临床医生角色，32 名通过委员会认证的精神科医生扮演患者，另一个由 15 名盲法、独立、通过委员会认证的精神科医生组成的评审小组对去标识化的对话记录进行评分。 训练后的智能体在 76.7% 的匹配场景对中得分高于使用相同提示词的基座模型（p<0.0001），在改编的临床检查实践技能评估（PACES）临床检查量表 40（dz=0.77，p<0.0001）、以患者为中心的沟通 108（p<0.001）、鉴别诊断恰当性（p<0.001）以及管理计划恰当性（p=0.018）方面均优于基座模型。

paragraphs.en: Automated psychiatric intake evaluation suite (Section 2.2 ): To support automated multi-turn evaluation of psychiatric interviewing, we curated 127 psychiatrist-validated clinical intake scenarios ( AC1 = 0.93 \text{AC1}=0.93 ) covering eight diagnostic domains and four difficulty tiers that gate diagnostically critical information behind rapport and clinical inquiry. Across these scenarios, as graded by a language-model autorater (Gemini 3.1 Pro), the trained agent nearly doubled its base model’s clinical rubric score (0.706 vs. 0.379; composite reward 0.564 vs. 0.294, p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), with substantial gains across all four difficulty tiers, an overall advantage preserved under an independent out-of-family judge model (OpenAI GPT-5.6-Luna, p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ).
paragraphs.zh: 自动化精神科接诊评估套件（第2.2节）：为支持精神科访谈的自动化多轮评估，我们精心构建了127个经精神科医生验证的临床接诊场景（\text{AC1}=0.93），涵盖八个诊断领域和四个难度层级，这些场景将诊断关键信息设置在建立融洽关系与临床问询之后。 在这些场景中，由语言模型自动评分器（Gemini 3.1 Pro）评分，训练后的智能体使其基础模型的临床量规得分几乎翻倍（0.706 对 0.379；复合奖励 0.564 对 0.294，p<0.0001），在全部四个难度层级上均取得显著提升，且在独立的非同族评审模型（OpenAI GPT-5.6-Luna，p<0.0001）下整体优势依然保持。

paragraphs.en: Adversarial stress-testing grounded in Delphi-consensus safety taxonomies (Section 2.3 ): To systematically probe conversational safety, two multidisciplinary Delphi panels established consensus taxonomies of clinical safety risks (6 domains, 21 risks) and relational competencies (5 domains, 18 competencies), from which we derived 256 adversarial patient presentations designed to elicit unsafe clinical behavior. Training more than halved under-triage of acute safety risks relative to the base model (12.9% vs. 30.5%, p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), though residual failures remained.
paragraphs.zh: 基于德尔菲共识安全分类法的对抗性压力测试（第2.3节）：为系统性地探测对话安全性，两个多学科德尔菲专家小组就临床安全风险（6个领域、21种风险）和关系能力（5个领域、18种能力）建立了共识分类法，并据此设计了256个旨在诱发出不安全临床行为的对抗性患者情境。 相对于基础模型，训练使急性安全风险的分诊不足减少了一半以上（12.9% 对 30.5%，p < 0.0001 p<0.0001），但仍存在残余失败。

paragraphs.en: All evaluations used synchronous English-language text consultations with standardized or simulated patients grounded in US psychiatric practice guidelines, demonstrating interviewing and diagnostic competence in controlled settings rather than outcomes, safety, or efficacy in real care, where any clinical use would require direct clinician oversight instead of autonomous operation.
paragraphs.zh: 所有评估均采用与标准化或模拟患者进行的同步英文文本会诊，并以美国精神科执业指南为依据，证明的是受控环境中的访谈与诊断能力，而非真实医疗中的结局、安全性或有效性；在真实医疗中，任何临床使用都需要临床医生直接监督，而非自主运行。

paragraphs.en: We report three findings. First, in a randomized, double-blind OSCE with psychiatrists role-playing patients, the simulation-trained agent outperformed its identically prompted base model, with gains in clinical examination skills, patient-centered communication, differential diagnosis formulation, and initial management planning (Section 2.1 ). Second, under automated evaluation the same advantage held across 127 expert-validated intake scenarios, and a three-way comparison on the 60 OSCE scenarios located where simulated evaluation departs from the human study (Section 2.2 ). Third, under adversarial presentations, training reduced but did not eliminate unsafe behavior, and the residual failures were mainly under-triage and missed red flags, including errors of omission that post-hoc output filters cannot intercept because no overtly harmful text is generated, such as failing to ask the probing questions needed to uncover a concealed crisis or failing to escalate care (Section 2.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告三项发现。 第一，在一项由精神科医生扮演患者的随机双盲OSCE（客观结构化临床考试）中，经过模拟训练的智能体表现优于使用完全相同提示词的基座模型，在临床检查技能、以患者为中心的沟通、鉴别诊断的制定以及初步处置规划方面均有提升（第2.1节）。 第二，在自动化评估下，同样的优势在127个经专家验证的接诊场景中依然成立，并且在60个OSCE场景上开展的三方比较定位了模拟评估与人类研究产生分歧之处（第2.2节）。 第三，在对抗性表现下，训练减少了但并未消除不安全行为，且残留的失败主要是分诊不足和漏判危险信号，包括一些疏漏性错误——由于没有生成任何明显有害的文本，事后输出过滤器无法拦截这类错误，例如未能提出揭示隐藏危机所需的探查性问题，或未能升级诊疗（第2.3节）。

paragraphs.en: To test whether clinical competencies acquired in simulation transfer to human encounters, we compared the simulation-trained agent against its base model (Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite 51 ) in a randomized, double-blind crossover OSCE ( N = 60 N{=}60 matched scenario pairs, 120 synchronous English-language text consultations; Fig. 2 a) covering mood, anxiety, psychotic, personality, and substance use disorders, occult somatic mimics, and acute crises. Both models operated under the exact same detailed clinical system prompt instructing structured history-taking, rapport-building, safety screening, and differential formulation, alongside identical tools and prompts, isolating the effect of multi-turn reinforcement learning in simulation from prompt engineering (Methods, Section 4.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为检验模拟训练中获得的临床能力能否迁移到真实人际接诊中，我们将接受模拟训练的智能体与其基础模型（Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite 51）进行了比较，采用随机、双盲交叉设计的客观结构化临床考试（OSCE，N{=}60 个匹配情景对，120 次同步英文文本问诊；图 2a），涵盖心境障碍、焦虑障碍、精神病性障碍、人格障碍、物质使用障碍、隐匿的躯体疾病拟态以及急性危机。 两个模型在完全相同的详细临床系统提示词下运行，该提示词要求进行结构化病史采集、建立融洽关系、安全性筛查以及鉴别诊断构思，并配备完全相同的工具与提示词，从而将模拟中多轮强化学习的效果与提示词工程的影响分离开来（方法，第 4.5 节）。

paragraphs.en: In each pair, one of 32 board-certified psychiatrists (Supplementary Table 5 ; Appendix A.1 ) enacted the same standardized patient across separate consultations with both models. Psychiatrists served as patient actors in this preliminary study to avoid exposing real patients to an unvalidated system and to adjudicate each scenario’s clinical information-gating protocol in real time, judging turn by turn whether the agent established rapport, navigated alliance ruptures, and conducted targeted inquiry before disclosing diagnostically critical facts (such as prior treatment responses, underlying medical symptoms, or guarded risk factors), prior to the agent submitting a ranked differential diagnosis and structured management plan at consultation end. Encounters were evaluated from two complementary clinical perspectives using a battery adapted from prior clinical OSCE benchmarks 176 to capture distinct levels of interaction (Appendix A.4 ): immediately after each chat, the role-playing clinician-patient rated discrete communication behaviors via the 11-item binary Patient-Centered Communication Best Practice (PCCBP) checklist 108 , global consultation satisfaction via the General Medical Council Patient Questionnaire (GMCPQ) 17 , core empathy and welfare via four patient-facing PACES items 40 , and longitudinal psychotherapeutic goal, task, and bond alignment via the Working Alliance Inventory Short Revised (WAI-SR) 62 ; independently, a separate panel of 15 blinded, board-certified psychiatrists (Appendix A.2 ) graded the de-identified transcripts and clinical outputs against the corresponding 18-item specialist PACES clinical-skills rubric 40 , four differential diagnosis scales, and management appropriateness criteria. Encounters had no turn limit; the simulation-trained agent took a median of 60 clinician turns (maximum 165) and the base model 8 (maximum 17; Supplementary Fig. 1 a).
paragraphs.zh: 在每一组配对中，32位获得专科认证的精神科医生之一（补充表5；附录A.1）在分别与两个模型进行的独立问诊中扮演同一位标准化患者。 在这项初步研究中，精神科医生扮演患者角色，以避免让真实患者接触未经验证的系统，并对每个场景的临床信息门槛控制协议进行实时裁定，逐轮判断智能体是否建立了融洽关系、化解了医患联盟的破裂，并在披露对诊断至关重要的事实（如既往治疗反应、潜在躯体症状或受防护的危险因素）之前进行了有针对性的问询，随后智能体才在问诊结束时提交排序的鉴别诊断和结构化管理方案。 评估从两个互补的临床视角出发，采用改编自既往临床OSCE基准176的评估工具包，以捕捉不同层面的交互（附录A.4）：每次对话结束后立即由扮演临床医生-患者的角色通过11项二分类的患者中心沟通最佳实践（PCCBP）量表108评估具体沟通行为，通过医学总委员会患者问卷（GMCPQ）17评估问诊总体满意度，通过四项面向患者的PACES条目40评估核心共情与福祉，并通过工作联盟量表简版修订版（WAI-SR）62评估纵向的心理治疗目标、任务与关系的一致性；与此同时，由另一个独立的、由15名盲态的精神科专科认证医生组成的评审小组（附录A.2）根据去标识化的对话记录和临床产出，对照相应的18项PACES专科临床技能评分表40、四项鉴别诊断量表以及管理适宜性标准进行评分。 问诊没有轮次限制；经过模拟训练的智能体中位数为60个医生轮次（最大165轮次），而基础模型为8个轮次（最大17轮次；补充图1a）。

sents.zh: 在这项初步研究中，精神科医生扮演患者角色，以避免让真实患者接触未经验证的系统，并对每个场景的临床信息门槛控制协议进行实时裁定，逐轮判断智能体是否建立了融洽关系、化解了医患联盟的破裂，并在披露对诊断至关重要的事实（如既往治疗反应、潜在躯体症状或受防护的危险因素）之前进行了有针对性的问询，随后智能体才在问诊结束时提交排序的鉴别诊断和结构化管理方案。

sents.en: Encounters were evaluated from two complementary clinical perspectives using a battery adapted from prior clinical OSCE benchmarks 176 to capture distinct levels of interaction (Appendix A.4 ): immediately after each chat, the role-playing clinician-patient rated discrete communication behaviors via the 11-item binary Patient-Centered Communication Best Practice (PCCBP) checklist 108 , global consultation satisfaction via the General Medical Council Patient Questionnaire (GMCPQ) 17 , core empathy and welfare via four patient-facing PACES items 40 , and longitudinal psychotherapeutic goal, task, and bond alignment via the Working Alliance Inventory Short Revised (WAI-SR) 62 ; independently, a separate panel of 15 blinded, board-certified psychiatrists (Appendix A.2 ) graded the de-identified transcripts and clinical outputs against the corresponding 18-item specialist PACES clinical-skills rubric 40 , four differential diagnosis scales, and management appropriateness criteria.
sents.zh: 评估从两个互补的临床视角出发，采用改编自既往临床OSCE基准176的评估工具包，以捕捉不同层面的交互（附录A.4）：每次对话结束后立即由扮演临床医生-患者的角色通过11项二分类的患者中心沟通最佳实践（PCCBP）量表108评估具体沟通行为，通过医学总委员会患者问卷（GMCPQ）17评估问诊总体满意度，通过四项面向患者的PACES条目40评估核心共情与福祉，并通过工作联盟量表简版修订版（WAI-SR）62评估纵向的心理治疗目标、任务与关系的一致性；与此同时，由另一个独立的、由15名盲态的精神科专科认证医生组成的评审小组（附录A.2）根据去标识化的对话记录和临床产出，对照相应的18项PACES专科临床技能评分表40、四项鉴别诊断量表以及管理适宜性标准进行评分。

sents.en: Encounters had no turn limit; the simulation-trained agent took a median of 60 clinician turns (maximum 165) and the base model 8 (maximum 17; Supplementary Fig. 1 a).
sents.zh: 问诊没有轮次限制；经过模拟训练的智能体中位数为60个医生轮次（最大165轮次），而基础模型为8个轮次（最大17轮次；补充图1a）。

paragraphs.en: The simulation-trained agent received a higher aggregate independent transcript rating than the base model in 76.7% of matched scenario pairs (46 of 60, 95% CI [64.0%, 86.6%], p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 , two-sided exact sign test; Fig. 2 b). The same ratings favored the trained agent over the base model in 80.7% of decisive (non-tied) pairs for PACES clinical skill (46 of 57, p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), 77.8% for diagnostic reasoning and differential formulation (42 of 54, p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), and 64.3% for PACES management and behavioral-enablement sub-dimensions (Items 12 and 17: 36 of 56, p = 0.044 p=0.044 ; Appendix A.5 ; the standalone overall management appropriateness item also reached significance, p = 0.018 p=0.018 , below).
paragraphs.zh: 在76.7%的匹配情境对中（60对中的46对，95% CI [64.0%, 86.6%]，p < 0.0001 p<0.0001，双侧精确符号检验；图2b），经模拟训练的智能体获得的独立转录文本综合评分高于基础模型。 在有明确胜负（非平局）的对中，相同的评分在以下方面更倾向于训练后的智能体而非基础模型：PACES 临床技能占80.7%（57对中的46对，p < 0.0001 p<0.0001），诊断推理与鉴别诊断构建占77.8%（54对中的42对，p < 0.0001 p<0.0001），PACES 管理与行为促成子维度占64.3%（条目12和17：56对中的36对，p = 0.044 p=0.044；附录A.5；独立的总体管理适当性条目也达到显著性，p = 0.018 p=0.018，见下文）。

paragraphs.en: The simulation-trained agent scored higher than the base model on the adapted 18-item PACES clinical-skills rubric (3.04 vs. 2.32 out of 5.0, shifting mean performance from the Unfavorable [ 2.0 2.0 ] range above the Satisfactory [ 3.0 3.0 ] scale anchor while remaining below Favorable [ 4.0 4.0 ]; mean paired difference + 0.73 +0.73 from unrounded scores, 95% CI [ + 0.49 +0.49 , + 0.96 +0.96 ]; d z = 0.77 d_{z}=0.77 , p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 , Wilcoxon signed-rank test; Fig. 2 c). Immediate post-encounter ratings from the live clinician-patients on the four patient-facing PACES items were concordant in direction and magnitude (3.18 vs. 2.63, d z = 0.45 d_{z}=0.45 , p = 0.0017 p=0.0017 ).
paragraphs.zh: 经模拟训练的智能体在改编后的18项PACES临床技能评分量表上的得分高于基础模型（3.04 vs. 2.32，满分5.0），使平均表现从「不佳」（[ 2.0 2.0 ]）区间提升至「满意」（[ 3.0 3.0 ]）量表锚点之上，同时仍低于「良好」（[ 4.0 4.0 ]）；配对均值差 + 0.73 +0.73（基于未舍入分数），95% 置信区间 [ + 0.49 +0.49 , + 0.96 +0.96 ]；d z = 0.77 d_{z}=0.77 ，p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 （Wilcoxon 符号秩检验；图 2c）。 现场临床医生-患者对四项面向患者的 PACES 条目在访谈结束后的即时评分在方向和幅度上均一致（3.18 vs. 2.63，d z = 0.45 d_{z}=0.45 ，p = 0.0017 p=0.0017 ）。

paragraphs.en: As rated by independent evaluators, the simulation-trained agent scored higher than the base model on all 18 PACES clinical-skills sub-dimensions (Fig. 2 c; item definitions in Supplementary Table 1 ), reaching nominal statistical significance on 17 (all except fostering the relationship, + 0.20 +0.20 , d z = 0.12 d_{z}=0.12 , p = 0.38 p=0.38 ). The largest gains concentrated in foundational history-taking, including past medical history ( + 1.21 +1.21 , d z = 0.87 d_{z}=0.87 , p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), review of systems ( + 1.10 +1.10 , d z = 0.86 d_{z}=0.86 , p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), presenting complaint characterization ( + 0.82 +0.82 , d z = 0.62 d_{z}=0.62 , p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), medication history reconciliation ( + 0.81 +0.81 , d z = 0.53 d_{z}=0.53 , p = 0.0006 p=0.0006 ), and family history ( + 0.64 +0.64 , d z = 0.51 d_{z}=0.51 , p = 0.0019 p=0.0019 ). Information gathering ( + 0.81 +0.81 , d z = 0.72 d_{z}=0.72 , p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ) and differential diagnosis construction ( + 0.95 +0.95 , d z = 0.60 d_{z}=0.60 , p = 0.0009 p=0.0009 ) also improved substantially, alongside gains across all explanation quality, shared decision-making, management selection, and emotional responsiveness sub-dimensions ( d z = 0.32 d_{z}=0.32 – 0.53 0.53 , all p ≤ 0.028 p\leq 0.028 ).
paragraphs.zh: 根据独立评估者的评分，经仿真训练的智能体在 PACES 临床技能全部 18 个子维度上的得分均高于基础模型（图 2c；各条目定义见补充表 1），其中 17 个子维度达到名义上的统计学显著性（仅“促进医患关系”除外，+0.20，d_z = 0.12，p = 0.38）。 提升幅度最大的是基础病史采集相关维度，包括既往史（+1.21，d_z = 0.87，p < 0.0001）、系统回顾（+1.10，d_z = 0.86，p < 0.0001）、主诉特征刻画（+0.82，d_z = 0.62，p < 0.0001）、用药史核对（+0.81，d_z = 0.53，p = 0.0006）以及家族史（+0.64，d_z = 0.51，p = 0.0019）。 信息采集（+0.81，d_z = 0.72，p < 0.0001）和鉴别诊断构建（+0.95，d_z = 0.60，p = 0.0009）也显著改善，同时在所有解释质量、共同决策、治疗方案选择和情感回应等子维度上均有提升（d_z = 0.32–0.53，所有 p ≤ 0.028）。

paragraphs.en: The simulation-trained agent produced better-rated diagnostic formulations than the base model on all four dimensions assessed by independent psychiatrists (Fig. 2 d; item definitions in Supplementary Table 2 ), including differential appropriateness (3.73 vs. 2.82), differential comprehensiveness (2.80 vs. 1.88; 1–4 scale, n = 59 n{=}59 complete pairs), inclusion of the probable diagnosis (3.93 vs. 3.13), and identification of plausible alternative causes (3.83 vs. 3.05; 1–5 scale; d z = 0.36 d_{z}=0.36 – 0.71 0.71 , all p ≤ 0.0074 p\leq 0.0074 ). Dichotomizing each dimension at a favorable rating ( ≥ 4 \geq 4 on 5-point scales; ≥ 3 \geq 3 on the 4-point comprehensiveness scale) preserved this advantage across all four dimensions (appropriateness: 68.3% vs. 33.3%, h = 0.72 h=0.72 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ; comprehensiveness: 67.8% vs. 32.2%, h = 0.73 h=0.73 ; probable diagnosis: 68.3% vs. 40.0%, h = 0.58 h=0.58 ; alternative diagnoses: 63.3% vs. 40.0%, h = 0.47 h=0.47 ). Averaged across the four dimensions, clinical reasoning scores were higher for the trained agent than for the base model (3.57 vs. 2.73, d z = 0.55 d_{z}=0.55 , p = 0.00014 p=0.00014 ). Evaluator-rated clinical confabulation (inventing unmentioned clinical details during the consultation or falsely recording in the post-encounter summary that the patient endorsed or denied symptoms never discussed; Item 28 in Supplementary Table 2 ) occurred in 1 of 60 trained-agent encounters (1.7%) versus 5 of 60 for the base model (8.3%; p = 0.22 p=0.22 , McNemar’s exact test). In absolute terms, mean ratings for the trained agent remained below the favorable anchor on all four dimensions (below 4 on the three 5-point scales [3.73–3.93] and below 3 on the 4-point comprehensiveness scale [2.80]).
paragraphs.zh: 经过仿真训练的智能体在独立精神科医生评估的全部四个维度上均产生了优于基础模型的诊断表述评分（图 2 d；条目定义见补充表 2），包括鉴别诊断的适当性（3.73 对 2.82）、鉴别诊断的全面性（2.80 对 1.88；1–4 分量表，n = 59 n{=}59 组完整配对）、纳入可能诊断（3.93 对 3.13），以及识别合理的替代病因（3.83 对 3.05；1–5 分量表；d z = 0.36 d_{z}=0.36 – 0.71 0.71 ，所有 p ≤ 0.0074 p\leq 0.0074 ）。 将每个维度在有利评分处二分化（5 分量表上 ≥ 4 \geq 4 分；4 分全面性量表上 ≥ 3 \geq 3 分）后，智能体在全部四个维度上均保持这一优势（适当性：68.3% 对 33.3%，h = 0.72 h=0.72 ，p < 0.001 p<0.001 ；全面性：67.8% 对 32.2%，h = 0.73 h=0.73 ；可能诊断：68.3% 对 40.0%，h = 0.58 h=0.58 ；替代诊断：63.3% 对 40.0%，h = 0.47 h=0.47 ）。 在四个维度上取平均后，经过训练的智能体的临床推理得分高于基础模型（3.57 对 2.73，d z = 0.55 d_{z}=0.55 ，p = 0.00014 p=0.00014 ）。 评估者评定的临床虚构（在问诊中编造未提及的临床细节，或在会诊后总结中虚假记录患者曾认可或否认从未讨论过的症状；补充表 2 中的条目 28）在 60 次经过训练的智能体问诊中发生 1 次（1.7%），而基础模型为 60 次中发生 5 次（8.3%；p = 0.22 p=0.22 ，McNemar 精确检验）。 从绝对值来看，经过训练的智能体在全部四个维度上的平均评分仍低于有利锚点（三个 5 分量表上低于 4 分 [3.73–3.93]，4 分全面性量表上低于 3 分 [2.80]）。

paragraphs.en: Clinician-patients recorded higher adherence for the simulation-trained agent than for the base model across the 11-item patient-centered communication checklist (PCCBP 108 ) completed immediately after each encounter (82.0% vs. 65.2%, d z = 0.49 d_{z}=0.49 , p = 0.00054 p=0.00054 ; Fig. 2 g; item definitions in Supplementary Table 3 ), with directionally higher adherence across all 11 items across encounters (and 10 of 11 on complete non-N/A pairs). The largest gains concentrated in relational competencies, including partnership building (68.8% vs. 35.4%, p = 0.0017 p=0.0017 ), encouraging patient participation (86.8% vs. 54.7%, p = 0.0002 p=0.0002 ), expressing care and commitment (84.9% vs. 56.6%, p = 0.0011 p=0.0011 ), building rapport (76.4% vs. 56.4%, p = 0.022 p=0.022 ), and greeting the patient appropriately (100.0% vs. 85.7%, p = 0.0082 p=0.0082 ; McNemar’s tests). Differences on the remaining six items, where baseline adherence was already high or the item rarely applied in a single intake (such as using appropriate language, appearing open and honest, acknowledging mistakes, or discussing roles and privacy), did not reach significance ( p ≥ 0.059 p\geq 0.059 ).

paragraphs.en: The same battery included four patient-facing PACES communication items, on all of which the trained agent scored higher than the base model: perceived empathy (3.39 vs. 2.89), confirming patient understanding (2.69 vs. 2.08), maintaining patient welfare (3.60 vs. 3.02), and detecting and addressing patient concerns (2.91 vs. 2.40; all p < 0.02 p<0.02 , d z = 0.35 d_{z}=0.35 – 0.46 0.46 ). On the General Medical Council Patient Questionnaire (GMCPQ; 9 Likert communication items in Supplementary Table 3 ), scores were directionally higher for the trained agent without reaching significance (3.01 vs. 2.79, d z = 0.19 d_{z}=0.19 , p = 0.091 p=0.091 ; Fig. 2 f). Clinician-patients marked the Working Alliance Inventory Short Revised (WAI-SR) 62 as entirely not applicable in 41.7% (50 of 120) of encounters, reflecting that its longitudinal psychotherapy items (such as agreeing on ongoing therapy tasks and goals) often do not apply to a single diagnostic intake. Among the 21 pairs with evaluable data, WAI-SR scores did not differ significantly between conditions (2.45 vs. 2.48, p = 0.75 p=0.75 ), and we treat this comparison as inconclusive (Appendix A.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 同一套题组包含四个面向患者的 PACES 沟通条目，训练后的智能体在所有条目上的得分均高于基础模型：感知共情（3.39 对 2.89）、确认患者理解（2.69 对 2.08）、维护患者福祉（3.60 对 3.02）以及发现并回应患者顾虑（2.91 对 2.40；均 p < 0.02 p<0.02 ，d z = 0.35 d_{z}=0.35 – 0.46 0.46 ）。 在英国医学总会患者问卷（GMCPQ；见补充表 3 中的 9 个李克特沟通条目）上，训练后的智能体得分呈方向性更高，但未达到显著性水平（3.01 对 2.79，d z = 0.19 d_{z}=0.19 ，p = 0.091 p=0.091 ；图 2f）。 临床医生扮演的患者在 41.7%（120 次就诊中的 50 次）中将工作同盟量表简明修订版（WAI-SR）62 的所有条目标记为完全不适用，这反映出其纵向心理治疗条目（如就持续治疗的任务和目标达成一致）往往不适用于单次诊断性接诊。 在 21 对有可评估数据的配对中，两种条件下的 WAI-SR 得分无显著差异（2.45 对 2.48，p = 0.75 p=0.75 ），我们将该比较视为结论不确定（附录 A.3 ）。

paragraphs.en: The simulation-trained agent recommended comprehensive and appropriate treatments (46.7% vs. 26.7%, p = 0.023 p=0.023 , McNemar’s test; Fig. 2 e) and diagnostic investigations (50.0% vs. 28.3%, p = 0.020 p=0.020 ) significantly more often than the base model, and achieved higher overall management plan appropriateness (3.67 vs. 3.18, d z = 0.31 d_{z}=0.31 , p = 0.018 p=0.018 , Wilcoxon signed-rank test; Item 27 in Supplementary Table 2 ), concordant with gains on the PACES sub-dimensions for selecting an appropriate management plan (3.23 vs. 2.62, d z = 0.34 d_{z}=0.34 , p = 0.018 p=0.018 ) and enabling treatment-related behavior (2.69 vs. 2.20, d z = 0.38 d_{z}=0.38 , p = 0.028 p=0.028 ). Both models avoided inappropriate treatments (88.3% vs. 80.0%, p = 0.20 p=0.20 ) and inappropriate investigations (83.3% vs. 83.3%, p = 1.00 p=1.00 ) in most encounters, though management remained more challenging than history elicitation or diagnostic formulation, with less than comprehensive treatment recommended in 53.3% of trained-agent encounters and an inappropriate treatment recommended in 11.7% (versus 20.0% for the base model).
paragraphs.zh: 经过模拟训练的智能体推荐全面且恰当治疗的频率显著高于基础模型（46.7% 对 26.7%，p = 0.023，McNemar 检验；图 2e），推荐诊断性检查的频率亦显著更高（50.0% 对 28.3%，p = 0.020），且整体管理方案的恰当性得分更高（3.67 对 3.18，d_z = 0.31，p = 0.018，Wilcoxon 符号秩检验；补充表 2 第 27 项），这与智能体在 PACES 中「选择恰当管理方案」（3.23 对 2.62，d_z = 0.34，p = 0.018）和「促成治疗相关行为」（2.69 对 2.20，d_z = 0.38，p = 0.028）两个子维度上的提升相一致。 两个模型在大多数就诊情境中都能避免不恰当的治疗（88.3% 对 80.0%，p = 0.20）和不恰当的检查（83.3% 对 83.3%，p = 1.00），不过管理仍比病史采集或诊断构建更具挑战性：在经过训练的智能体的就诊中，有 53.3% 的情况推荐的治疗不够全面，11.7% 推荐了不恰当的治疗（基础模型为 20.0%）。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate interactive interviewing across a broader diagnostic spectrum, we assessed the models across 127 simulated psychiatric intake scenarios independently validated by 54 board-certified psychiatrists (inter-rater agreement Gwet’s AC1 = 0.93 \text{AC1}=0.93 ; Fig. 3 a; Methods, Section 4.6 ; Supplementary Table 4 ). Covering eight clinical domains across four difficulty tiers ( Easy , Medium , Hard , and Edge ), each scenario pairs the candidate model with a dynamic patient simulator that updates patient mood and communicative reliability in response to clinician empathy and inquiry, gating diagnostically critical facts behind rapport and targeted probing (Methods, Section 4.2 ). At consultation end, an automated evaluator (Gemini 3.1 Pro) grades the full trajectory and submitted clinical outputs against a 28-item clinical rubric ( R clinical ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] R_{\text{clinical}}\in[0,1] ) spanning five categories (diagnostic appropriateness, psychiatric management, alliance and communication, psychiatric assessment, and documentation quality; Supplementary Table 7 ), combined with safety and completeness penalties to yield a normalized composite clinical reward (Methods, Section 4.3 ; Appendix C.2 ). To test how substituting the patient actor and rater affects measured gains, we compared all three settings across the 60 shared OSCE scenarios (Fig. 3 c–f; Methods, Section 4.7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了在更广泛的诊断范围内评估交互式问诊，我们在127个由54位委员会认证的精神科医生独立验证的模拟精神科接诊场景中评估了模型（评分者间一致性 Gwet's AC1 = 0.93 \text{AC1}=0.93 ；图 3a；方法，第 4.6 节；补充表 4）。 这些场景覆盖四个难度层级（简单、中等、困难、边缘）的八个临床领域，每个场景将候选模型与一个动态患者模拟器配对，该模拟器会根据临床医生的共情与提问更新患者情绪和沟通可靠性，并将诊断上关键的信息隐藏在建立信任关系与针对性探询之后（方法，第 4.2 节）。 在问诊结束时，一个自动化评估器（Gemini 3.1 Pro）依据一份包含28个条目的临床评分量表（ R_{\text{clinical}}\in[0,1] ，涵盖五个类别：诊断适当性、精神科管理、治疗联盟与沟通、精神科评估以及文档质量；补充表 7）对完整对话轨迹和提交的临床输出进行评分，并结合安全性与完整性惩罚，得出归一化的综合临床奖励（方法，第 4.3 节；附录 C.2）。 为了测试替换患者扮演者和评分者如何影响测量到的收益，我们在60个共享的OSCE场景中比较了全部三种设置（图 3c–f；方法，第 4.7 节）。

paragraphs.en: The simulation-trained agent achieved a pre-penalty clinical rubric score of 0.706 vs. 0.379 (+86%) and a normalized composite clinical reward of 0.564 [0.529, 0.599] vs. 0.294 [0.281, 0.308] ( + 0.270 +0.270 on the [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] normalized reward scale, p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ; Fig. 1 , Fig. 3 b, Supplementary Table 6 , Appendix C.2 ). Substantial gains occurred across all four difficulty tiers ( Easy : 0.646 vs. 0.335, + 0.311 +0.311 ; Medium : 0.571 vs. 0.318, + 0.253 +0.253 ; Hard : 0.536 vs. 0.277, + 0.259 +0.259 ; Edge : 0.513 vs. 0.250, + 0.263 +0.263 ), such that the trained agent’s Edge -tier score (0.513) exceeded its base model’s Easy -tier score (0.335). Across the five clinical rubric categories, training approximately doubled scores relative to the base model in management (0.678 vs. 0.377), diagnostic appropriateness (0.682 vs. 0.369), and psychiatric assessment (0.673 vs. 0.323), with the largest gain in alliance and communication (0.827 vs. 0.321) and a smaller gain in documentation quality (0.689 vs. 0.647; Supplementary Table 7 ). Training also reduced the automated hallucination penalty rate (unsupported factual assertions, invented clinical guidelines, or fabricated patient statements) from 46.5% to 3.1% and the critical-question omission rate from 96.9% to 60.6%. Under an independent out-of-family judge (OpenAI GPT-5.6-Luna), the advantage held in every difficulty tier but was smaller (0.443 [0.415, 0.471] vs. 0.278 [0.268, 0.289] , p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ; difference between models 0.165 vs. 0.270 under Gemini 3.1 Pro; Supplementary Table 8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 经仿真训练的智能体在扣分前临床量表评分上达到0.706，对比0.379（提升86%），归一化综合临床奖励为0.564 [0.529, 0.599]，对比0.294 [0.281, 0.308]（在 [0,1] 归一化奖励量表上提高 +0.270，p < 0.0001；图1、图3b、补充表6、附录C.2）。 在全部四个难度层级上均有显著提升（简单：0.646 对比 0.335，+0.311；中等：0.571 对比 0.318，+0.253；困难：0.536 对比 0.277，+0.259；边缘：0.513 对比 0.250，+0.263），以至于训练后智能体的边缘层级评分（0.513）超过了其基础模型在简单层级的评分（0.335）。 在五个临床量表类别中，训练使智能体在管理（0.678 对比 0.377）、诊断适当性（0.682 对比 0.369）和精神科评估（0.673 对比 0.323）方面的评分相对于基础模型约翻了一番，其中治疗联盟与沟通方面的提升最大（0.827 对比 0.321），而病历记录质量方面的提升较小（0.689 对比 0.647；补充表7）。 训练还将自动幻觉惩罚率（无依据的事实性断言、虚构的临床指南或捏造的患者陈述）从46.5%降至3.1%，并将关键问题遗漏率从96.9%降至60.6%。 在一个独立的跨家族评审模型（OpenAI GPT-5.6-Luna）下，该优势在每个难度层级均保持成立，但幅度较小（0.443 [0.415, 0.471] 对比 0.278 [0.268, 0.289]，p < 0.0001；两模型差异为0.165，而在 Gemini 3.1 Pro 下为0.270；补充表8）。

sents.en: The simulation-trained agent achieved a pre-penalty clinical rubric score of 0.706 vs. 0.379 (+86%) and a normalized composite clinical reward of 0.564 [0.529, 0.599] vs. 0.294 [0.281, 0.308] ( + 0.270 +0.270 on the [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] normalized reward scale, p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ; Fig. 1 , Fig. 3 b, Supplementary Table 6 , Appendix C.2 ).
sents.zh: 经仿真训练的智能体在扣分前临床量表评分上达到0.706，对比0.379（提升86%），归一化综合临床奖励为0.564 [0.529, 0.599]，对比0.294 [0.281, 0.308]（在 [0,1] 归一化奖励量表上提高 +0.270，p < 0.0001；图1、图3b、补充表6、附录C.2）。

sents.en: Substantial gains occurred across all four difficulty tiers ( Easy : 0.646 vs. 0.335, + 0.311 +0.311 ; Medium : 0.571 vs. 0.318, + 0.253 +0.253 ; Hard : 0.536 vs. 0.277, + 0.259 +0.259 ; Edge : 0.513 vs. 0.250, + 0.263 +0.263 ), such that the trained agent’s Edge -tier score (0.513) exceeded its base model’s Easy -tier score (0.335).
sents.zh: 在全部四个难度层级上均有显著提升（简单：0.646 对比 0.335，+0.311；中等：0.571 对比 0.318，+0.253；困难：0.536 对比 0.277，+0.259；边缘：0.513 对比 0.250，+0.263），以至于训练后智能体的边缘层级评分（0.513）超过了其基础模型在简单层级的评分（0.335）。

sents.en: Across the five clinical rubric categories, training approximately doubled scores relative to the base model in management (0.678 vs. 0.377), diagnostic appropriateness (0.682 vs. 0.369), and psychiatric assessment (0.673 vs. 0.323), with the largest gain in alliance and communication (0.827 vs. 0.321) and a smaller gain in documentation quality (0.689 vs. 0.647; Supplementary Table 7 ).
sents.zh: 在五个临床量表类别中，训练使智能体在管理（0.678 对比 0.377）、诊断适当性（0.682 对比 0.369）和精神科评估（0.673 对比 0.323）方面的评分相对于基础模型约翻了一番，其中治疗联盟与沟通方面的提升最大（0.827 对比 0.321），而病历记录质量方面的提升较小（0.689 对比 0.647；补充表7）。

sents.en: Training also reduced the automated hallucination penalty rate (unsupported factual assertions, invented clinical guidelines, or fabricated patient statements) from 46.5% to 3.1% and the critical-question omission rate from 96.9% to 60.6%.
sents.zh: 训练还将自动幻觉惩罚率（无依据的事实性断言、虚构的临床指南或捏造的患者陈述）从46.5%降至3.1%，并将关键问题遗漏率从96.9%降至60.6%。

sents.en: Under an independent out-of-family judge (OpenAI GPT-5.6-Luna), the advantage held in every difficulty tier but was smaller (0.443 [0.415, 0.471] vs. 0.278 [0.268, 0.289] , p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ; difference between models 0.165 vs. 0.270 under Gemini 3.1 Pro; Supplementary Table 8 ).
sents.zh: 在一个独立的跨家族评审模型（OpenAI GPT-5.6-Luna）下，该优势在每个难度层级均保持成立，但幅度较小（0.443 [0.415, 0.471] 对比 0.278 [0.268, 0.289]，p < 0.0001；两模型差异为0.165，而在 Gemini 3.1 Pro 下为0.270；补充表8）。

paragraphs.en: Error analysis identified incomplete diagnostic inquiry as the dominant failure mode for both conditions. At least one critical scoring-key topic was left unasked in 96.9% of base-model encounters and 60.6% of trained-agent encounters. Because this indicator triggers whenever any single item on the multi-topic diagnostic checklist is omitted (in contrast to the acute-harm red-flag metric in Section 2.3 ), these rates reflect the exhaustive completeness required across all gated history domains rather than an acute safety error rate. Training substantially reduced but did not eliminate the tendency to end encounters before eliciting all gated clinical information (median of 16 clinician turns [IQR 14–20] per simulated intake versus 9 turns [IQR 6–11] for the base model).
paragraphs.zh: 错误分析发现，不完整的诊断问询是两种病症中最主要的失败模式。 在基础模型接诊中有96.9%，在训练后智能体接诊中有60.6%，至少遗漏了一个关键评分标准要点而未询问。 由于该指标在多主题诊断清单中任意一项被遗漏时即会触发（与第2.3节中的急性危害红旗指标不同），这些比率反映的是跨所有门控病史领域的穷尽式完整性要求，而非急性安全错误率。 训练大幅减少但并未消除在问全所有门控临床信息之前结束接诊的倾向（每次模拟问诊的中位临床医生对话轮数为16轮[IQR 14–20]，而基础模型为9轮[IQR 6–11]）。

sents.en: Error analysis identified incomplete diagnostic inquiry as the dominant failure mode for both conditions.
sents.zh: 错误分析发现，不完整的诊断问询是两种病症中最主要的失败模式。

paragraphs.en: We compared three settings across the 60 OSCE scenario pairs: scores from the evaluating psychiatrists grading the human-patient transcripts (Section 2.1 ), the autorater grading the same transcripts, and the autorater grading simulated representations of the encounter using the patient simulator that the agent was trained in (Fig. 3 c–f; Methods, Section 4.7 ; Appendix C.3 ). Across the same transcripts, autorater scores show moderate correlation with the psychiatrists’ 22-item primary specialist composite within simulation-trained ( ρ = 0.58 \rho=0.58 , 95% CI [0.37, 0.73]) and base-model encounters ( ρ = 0.57 \rho=0.57 [0.34, 0.75]) and on per-scenario score differences between the two models ( Δ \Delta ; ρ = 0.40 \rho=0.40 [0.17, 0.59]; Fig. 3 c, e). Across the 60 pairs, the autorater preferred the simulation-trained transcript in 55 and the psychiatrists in 46 (both in 41, autorater only in 14, psychiatrist only in 5, both base in 0; 68.3% raw agreement vs. 72.2% chance agreement under skewed marginals; Cohen’s κ = − 0.14 \kappa=-0.14 ). Both raters favored the trained agent in every clinical category, with a larger standardized effect under the autorater (paired d z = 1.48 d_{z}=1.48 [1.21, 1.86] vs. 0.71 0.71 [0.47, 1.02] on the composite; Fig. 3 f; Supplementary Table 10 ), as d z d_{z} scales each rater’s mean gain by its own within-pair variability.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在60个OSCE场景对上比较了三种设置：评估精神科医生对人类患者记录的评分（第2.1节）、自动评分器对相同记录的评分，以及自动评分器对使用智能体所训练的患者模拟器生成的会诊模拟呈现的评分（图3c–f；方法，第4.7节；附录C.3）。 在相同记录上，自动评分器评分与精神科医生的22项专科主复合指标在模拟训练模型（ρ=0.58，95% CI [0.37, 0.73]）和基础模型的会诊（ρ=0.57 [0.34, 0.75]）中呈中等相关，并且在两个模型的逐场景评分差异上也是如此（Δ；ρ=0.40 [0.17, 0.59]；图3c, e）。 在这60对中，自动评分器在55对中偏好模拟训练模型的记录，精神科医生在46对中偏好模拟训练模型的记录（两者均偏好41对，仅自动评分器偏好14对，仅精神科医生偏好5对，两者均偏好基础模型0对；原始一致率为68.3%，而在偏斜边际分布下的偶然一致率为72.2%；Cohen's κ=−0.14）。 两位评分者在每个临床类别中都更偏好经训练的智能体，自动评分器的标准化效应更大（复合指标上配对d_z=1.48 [1.21, 1.86]，对比0.71 [0.47, 1.02]；图3f；补充表10），因为d_z会用各自的对内变异性来缩放每位评分者的平均增益。

paragraphs.en: Under the same autorater, replacing the clinician-patients with simulated patients shortened the trained agent’s interviews (median 16 vs. 60 clinician turns; 8 in both settings for the base model on this 60-scenario set; Supplementary Fig. 1 ), raised scores for both models ( + 0.23 +0.23 [0.19, 0.27] trained; + 0.10 +0.10 [0.08, 0.12] base), and enlarged the mean trained–base gain from 0.21 0.21 to 0.34 0.34 (difference + 0.13 +0.13 [0.09, 0.17]; Fig. 3 d). Across scenarios, simulated and clinician-patient scores under the autorater correlated moderately for the base model ( ρ = 0.68 \rho=0.68 [0.50, 0.82]) and for the trained agent ( ρ = 0.43 \rho=0.43 [0.18, 0.62]), and weakly on per-scenario differences Δ \Delta ( ρ = 0.14 \rho=0.14 [ − 0.12 -0.12 , 0.40]; against the psychiatrists’ ratings, ρ = 0.35 \rho=0.35 [0.11, 0.56] within base, 0.21 0.21 [ − 0.04 -0.04 , 0.44] within trained, and 0.09 0.09 [ − 0.17 -0.17 , 0.35] on Δ \Delta ; Fig. 3 d, e; Supplementary Table 9 ). Even so, simulated evaluation reproduced the direction of the training gain overall ( d z = 2.11 d_{z}=2.11 [1.84, 2.52] per rollout) and in every clinical category, with psychiatric assessment the largest effect across all three settings (Fig. 3 f).
paragraphs.zh: 在同一自动评估器下，用模拟患者替代临床医生扮演的患者缩短了训练后智能体的问诊长度（中位数 16 次对 60 次临床医生轮次；基础模型在该 60 个场景的集合中两种设置下均为 8 次；补充图 1），同时提高了两个模型的得分（+0.23 +0.23 [0.19, 0.27] 训练后模型；+0.10 +0.10 [0.08, 0.12] 基础模型），并将训练后模型相对基础模型的平均增益从 0.21 0.21 扩大到 0.34 0.34（差值 +0.13 +0.13 [0.09, 0.17]；图 3d）。 在各场景中，自动评估器给出的模拟患者与临床医生扮演患者的得分在基础模型上呈中度相关（ρ = 0.68 \rho=0.68 [0.50, 0.82]），在训练后智能体上也呈中度相关（ρ = 0.43 \rho=0.43 [0.18, 0.62]），而在逐场景差值 Δ \Delta 上呈弱相关（ρ = 0.14 \rho=0.14 [−0.12 -0.12, 0.40]；与精神科医生的评分相比，基础模型内为 ρ = 0.35 \rho=0.35 [0.11, 0.56]，训练后模型内为 0.21 0.21 [−0.04 -0.04, 0.44]，Δ \Delta 上为 0.09 0.09 [−0.17 -0.17, 0.35]；图 3d、e；补充表 9）。 尽管如此，模拟评估仍在总体上（每次 rollout d_z = 2.11 d_{z}=2.11 [1.84, 2.52]）以及每个临床类别中都重现了训练增益的方向，其中精神科评估在所有三种设置中效应最大（图 3f）。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate model safety and boundary maintenance under high-risk clinical challenges, we conducted an adversarial evaluation built on two expert-validated taxonomies (Table 1 ), testing clinical reasoning against patients who conceal crises behind benign complaints, fabricate symptom histories, escalate emotionally to circumvent boundaries, or refuse recommended care (Fig. 2 ; Table 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为评估模型在高风险临床挑战下的安全性与边界维护能力，我们开展了一项对抗性评估，该评估建立在两个经专家验证的分类体系之上（表1），针对以下患者情境测试临床推理能力：患者以良性主诉掩饰危重病情、编造症状病史、情绪升级以绕过边界，或拒绝推荐的医疗方案（图2；表2）。

paragraphs.en: We structured the adversarial evaluation around two complementary taxonomies developed through a modified Delphi consensus process (Table 1 ; Appendix D ):
paragraphs.zh: 我们围绕通过改进德尔菲共识流程建立的两个互补分类体系来构建对抗性评估（表1；附录D）：

paragraphs.en: Clinical safety taxonomy (6 domains, 21 risks; Table 1 a; Supplementary Table 12 ), which synthesizes five established safety frameworks 189 ; 1 ; 82 ; 150 ; 18 . A two-round Delphi panel of clinicians ( N = 16 N=16 in Round 1, N = 13 N=13 in Round 2) spanning psychiatry, patient safety, primary care, emergency medicine, surgery, and clinical informatics achieved S-CVI/Ave = 0.96, with all 21 items reaching ≥ \geq 80% consensus (Appendix D.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 临床安全分类体系（6个领域、21项风险；表1a；补充表12），该体系综合了五个已确立的安全框架189；1；82；150；18。 一项由临床医生组成的两轮德尔菲专家小组（第一轮 N=16，第二轮 N=13），涵盖精神医学、患者安全、初级保健、急诊医学、外科和临床信息学，达到 S-CVI/Ave = 0.96，且全部21个条目均达到 ≥80% 的共识（附录D.1）。

sents.en: Clinical safety taxonomy (6 domains, 21 risks; Table 1 a; Supplementary Table 12 ), which synthesizes five established safety frameworks 189 ; 1 ; 82 ; 150 ; 18 .

paragraphs.en: We generated 256 adversarial scenarios (four stratified sets of 64 cases across all risk categories), arranged across four difficulty levels weighted toward complex presentations: Easy ( n = 46 n=46 , 18.0%), Medium ( n = 58 n=58 , 22.7%), Hard ( n = 94 n=94 , 36.7%), and Edge ( n = 58 n=58 , 22.7%). Each specifies the presenting complaint, concealed safety-critical facts, adversarial escalation tactics, and a scenario-specific scoring checklist evaluating whether the agent identified concealed risks and maintained clinical boundaries under escalation without rupturing patient rapport. In addition to overall composite reward, the automated rubric tracks three specific clinical safety violation rates (Table 2 ): contraindications (prescribing or recommending a treatment that is unsafe given the patient’s medical comorbidities, concurrent medications, or physiological status), missed red flags (failing to detect or probe embedded warning signs of acute harm during history-taking), and under-triage (failing to escalate clinical disposition, i.e., the recommended post-encounter care setting and urgency level, to emergency or urgent psychiatric care when the patient’s presentation involves an active, life-threatening crisis). These evaluation scenarios were held out and deduplicated from the training mixture, and both models were evaluated at the policy level without external post-hoc output filters to measure intrinsic policy vulnerabilities directly (Section 4.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们生成了 256 个对抗性场景（四个分层集合，共 64 个案例，覆盖所有风险类别），分布在四个难度级别上，并向复杂表现倾斜：简单（n=46，18.0%）、中等（n=58，22.7%）、困难（n=94，36.7%）和边缘（n=58，22.7%）。 每个场景都规定了主诉、隐藏的安全关键事实、对抗性升级策略，以及一个针对具体场景的评分清单，用以评估智能体是否识别了隐藏的风险，并在升级过程中保持临床边界而不破坏医患关系。 除了总体综合奖励外，自动评分标准还跟踪三项特定的临床安全违规率（表 2）：禁忌症（在患者的合并症、合并用药或生理状态下开具或推荐不安全的治疗）、漏诊危险信号（在问诊过程中未能检测或探究潜藏的急性伤害警示信号）以及分诊不足（当患者的表现涉及正在发生的、危及生命的危机时，未能将临床处置（即推荐的就诊后照护场所和紧急程度）升级到急诊或紧急精神科照护）。 这些评估场景从训练混合数据中被保留并去重，两个模型均在策略层面进行评估，且不使用外部事后输出过滤器，以直接衡量策略本身的内在脆弱性（第 4.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: The trained agent achieved a normalized composite safety reward of 0.672 (versus 0.357 for the base model, p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ) and substantially reduced all three tracked safety violation rates relative to its base model, including contraindications (0.8% vs. 6.2%, p = 0.001 p=0.001 ), under-triage (12.9% vs. 30.5%, p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), and missed red flags (6.2% vs. 10.9%, p = 0.04 p=0.04 ; Table 2 ). Unlike the broad diagnostic-completeness checklist in Section 2.2 (where omitting any required history domain triggered the 60.6% critical-question omission indicator), the 6.2% missed red-flag rate specifically reflects failure to probe embedded warning signs of acute harm, indicating that safety-weighted RL penalties prioritized acute risk inquiry even when general intake questioning remained incomplete. These improvements suggest that multi-turn RL training can shape safety-relevant behaviors, including structured risk assessment routines and boundary maintenance under escalation pressure.
paragraphs.zh: 训练后的智能体取得了 0.672 的归一化综合安全奖励（基础模型为 0.357，p < 0.0001 p<0.0001），并且相对于其基础模型，大幅降低了所有三项受监测的安全违规率，包括禁忌证（0.8% 对 6.2%，p = 0.001 p=0.001）、分诊不足（12.9% 对 30.5%，p < 0.0001 p<0.0001）以及漏检危险信号（6.2% 对 10.9%，p = 0.04 p=0.04；表 2）。 与 2.2 节中宽泛的诊断完整性清单不同（在该清单中，遗漏任何必需的病史领域都会触发 60.6% 的关键问题遗漏指标），6.2% 的漏检危险信号率具体反映的是未能探查急性损害的嵌入式警示征兆，这表明安全加权的强化学习惩罚优先关注急性风险的询问，即使一般性的接诊问询仍不完整。 这些改进表明，多轮强化学习训练能够塑造与安全相关的行为，包括结构化的风险评估流程以及在升级压力下的边界维持。

paragraphs.en: The residual failure rate determines how such a system would have to be governed, and it is why we treat safety architecture external to the learned policy as a precondition rather than a recommendation. In 12.9% of adversarial scenarios (33 of 256, or approximately one in eight adversarial presentations), the trained agent did not escalate simulated patients with acute safety needs, most notably in presentations where a crisis was actively concealed behind benign somatic complaints. These failures typically involved sophisticated concealment, such as embedding lethal means access within ostensibly routine medical narratives.
paragraphs.zh: 残余失效率决定了此类系统必须如何被治理，这也正是我们将学习策略之外的安全架构视为前提条件而非建议的原因。 在12.9%的对抗性场景中（256例中的33例，即约八分之一的对抗性表现），训练后的智能体未能对具有急性安全需求的模拟患者进行升级处理，其中最突出的是那些危机被隐藏在良性躯体主诉之下的病例。 这些失败通常涉及复杂的隐藏手段，例如将获取致死工具的信息嵌入看似常规的医疗叙述之中。

paragraphs.en: We trained a language model with multi-turn reinforcement learning across simulated psychiatric encounters and validated it against its identically prompted base model in three settings. In a randomized, double-blind crossover OSCE with board-certified psychiatrists role-playing standardized patients, the trained agent received a higher independent transcript score than the base model in 76.7% of matched scenario pairs, with gains in clinical examination skills, patient-centered communication, and differential diagnosis formulation (Section 2.1 ). Across an automated evaluation of 127 clinician-validated psychiatric intake scenarios, it nearly doubled its base model’s pre-penalty clinical rubric score and substantially improved composite clinical reward, with gains across all four difficulty tiers (Section 2.2 ). Under 256 adversarial presentations designed to elicit unsafe clinical behavior, training more than halved under-triage relative to the base model, although residual failures remained (Section 2.3 ). Comparing the post-trained agent against its untuned base checkpoint under an identical clinical system prompt, tool interface, and reasoning-token budget isolates the combined effect of the simulation RL pipeline (spanning both adaptation to dynamic patient states and alignment to structured clinical rubrics) from prompt engineering or test-time compute. Because on-policy RL updates model weights from scalar rewards on self-generated trajectories without additional medical corpora, these results also show how far procedural gains carry across clinical tasks. In psychiatric intake, diagnostic reasoning and communication are more tightly coupled than in general medical consultations 176 ; 15 , where core symptom histories are less contingent on trust; accordingly, diagnostic formulation scaled with interpersonal and history-taking gains, consistent with building rapport and sustaining structured inquiry unlocking the gated patient disclosures needed to double differential diagnosis appropriateness (68.3% vs. 33.3% in the OSCE). paragraphs.en: Gains in patient-centered communication were broad, and clinician-patients rated the trained agent as displaying more empathic behavior than the base model during live interaction. These are best read as gains in procedural communication and structured empathic responding, captured in the same direction by all three communication instruments (PCCBP, GMCPQ, and the patient-facing PACES items), rather than as evidence of therapeutic alliance formation, which develops over sustained multi-session relationships 45 . Frequent not-applicable responses on the WAI-SR, an instrument designed for multi-session psychotherapy 62 , are consistent with this distinction (Appendix A.3 ). Whether simulation training also improves alliance in longitudinal settings remains an open question.
paragraphs.zh: 以患者为中心的沟通能力提升是广泛的，医患角色扮演者（clinician-patients）在实时互动中将受训的智能体评为比基础模型表现出更多共情行为。 这些结果最好理解为程序性沟通和结构化共情回应方面的提升——三份沟通评估工具（PCCBP、GMCPQ 以及面向患者的 PACES 条目）均以相同方向捕捉到这一点——而非治疗联盟形成的证据，因为治疗联盟需要在持续多次会话的关系中才能形成 45。 在专为多次会话心理治疗设计的 WAI-SR 工具上 62，频繁出现的“不适用”回答与这一区分相一致（附录 A.3）。 模拟训练是否也能改善纵向情境下的联盟，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。

paragraphs.en: Automated multi-turn evaluation complements clinician-enacted assessment by gating diagnostically critical information behind rapport and targeted inquiry, testing interactive clinical interviewing rather than static knowledge recall; the training gain was preserved under an independent out-of-family evaluator (Section 2.2 ; Appendix C.2 ). In the adversarial evaluation, simulation training substantially reduced contraindications, missed red flags, and under-triage, but did not eliminate failures when acute risk was concealed behind benign complaints. The composition of these residual failures has direct implications for safety governance. Deterministic guardrails can intercept generation-side harms such as a contraindicated prescription, because the harmful content is present in the output and can be filtered. They cannot address omissions in which the agent never asks the question that would have surfaced a concealed risk, because a post-hoc safety layer has no corresponding content on which to act. Mitigating omission failures therefore requires process-level safeguards external to free-text generation, including structured state-tracking checklists that gate encounter termination on mandatory safety and review-of-systems inquiry, real-time supervisory monitors that audit dialogue state for unprobed red flags, and clinician-in-the-loop verification at handoff. Beyond evaluating our trained model, the clinician-validated intake suite, adversarial stress-testing protocol, and Delphi taxonomies (Table 1 ) provide a structured methodology for auditing both commission and omission failures across conversational systems proposed for mental health settings.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化多轮评估为临床医生实施的评估提供了补充：它将诊断关键信息设置在建立信任关系和针对性问诊之后进行考察，从而测试交互式临床问诊能力而非静态知识记忆；在独立的外部族评估器下，训练带来的提升得以保持（第2.2节；附录C.2）。 在对抗性评估中，模拟训练显著减少了禁忌证用药、漏检危险信号和分诊不足，但当急性风险隐藏在良性主诉背后时，并未能消除失败。 这些残余失败的构成对安全治理具有直接启示。 确定性护栏可以拦截生成侧的危害（如开具禁忌药物处方），因为有害内容存在于输出中，可以被过滤。 但确定性护栏无法应对遗漏类失败，即智能体从未提出本可揭示隐藏风险的问题，因为事后安全层没有可以据以行动的对应内容。 因此，缓解遗漏类失败需要独立于自由文本生成之外的过程级保障措施，包括：通过结构化状态追踪清单来管控诊疗终止、强制要求完成安全问询和系统回顾问询；通过实时监督监视器审计对话状态、检查是否存在未被探查的危险信号；以及在交接时进行临床医生在环的核验。 除评估我们训练的模型外，经临床医生验证的接诊套件、对抗性压力测试协议和德尔菲分类法（表1）也为审计拟用于心理健康场景的对话系统的 commission 类失败和遗漏类失败提供了一套结构化方法。

paragraphs.en: How closely automated evaluation tracks clinical judgment is quantified by the three-way comparison on the 60 OSCE scenarios (Section 2.2 ). The autorater correlated moderately with the psychiatrists’ ratings on the same transcripts ( ρ = 0.57 \rho=0.57 – 0.58 0.58 ). Replacing both raters and patients preserved the direction of the training effect in every clinical category, but not its size ( d z = 2.11 d_{z}=2.11 vs. 0.71 0.71 with psychiatrists) nor its pattern across scenarios ( ρ = 0.09 \rho=0.09 on scenario-level gains). Simulated evaluation can therefore order and stress-test models, but neither estimate the size of their differences nor identify the scenarios on which one model outperforms another. As a training environment, however, the same simulator proved sufficient: the gains it produced held when psychiatrists role-played the patients and graded the transcripts.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化评估与临床判断的吻合程度通过在60个OSCE情景上的三方比较进行量化（见第2.2节）。 在相同的对话记录上，自动评分器与精神科医生的评分呈中等程度相关（ρ=0.57–0.58）。 同时替换评分者和患者后，在每个临床类别中训练效应的方向得以保留，但其大小（dz=2.11，而精神科医生评分为0.71）及其在各情景间的模式（情景层面增益的ρ=0.09）均未能保留。 因此，模拟评估能够对模型进行排序和压力测试，但既无法估计模型间差异的大小，也无法识别出一个模型优于另一个模型的具体情景。 然而，作为训练环境，同一个模拟器被证明是足够的：当精神科医生扮演患者并给对话记录评分时，它所产生的提升依然成立。

paragraphs.en: A documented gap in access to mental health services motivates this line of work. More than 75% of individuals with mental disorders in low- and middle-income countries receive no treatment 191 , and even in high-income settings, fewer than one in five individuals with major depressive disorder receive minimally adequate care 173 . Tele-psychiatry supports effective evaluation and treatment delivery for many presentations 71 , which suggests that the encounter format is not the primary barrier to competent assessment, but it does not change the supply of clinician time, since a synchronous consultation occupies a psychiatrist for its full duration whether remote or in person. Addressing this bottleneck does not, however, imply automating psychiatric evaluation or replacing psychiatrists, social workers, or intake clinicians. Given the complexity of psychiatric care and the substantial error rates observed even after simulation training, our findings do not support autonomous deployment of the present system; rather, any prospective near-term clinical role should be strictly assistive and clinician-supervised 75 ; 131 ; 53 , such as conducting a structured pre-visit intake to generate a provisional history and symptom summary that a supervising clinician reviews, verifies, and builds upon during the clinical encounter, potentially supplementing routine psychosocial intake or static questionnaires with structured medical review of systems, medication reconciliation, and preliminary differential screening for somatic mimics.
paragraphs.zh: 心理健康服务可及性方面存在有据可查的差距，这推动了这一方向的研究工作。 在中低收入国家，超过75%的精神障碍患者未接受任何治疗191；即使在高收入环境中，重性抑郁障碍患者中获得最低限度充分治疗的比例也不到五分之一173。 远程精神病学能够对许多病症开展有效的评估和治疗71，这表明就诊形式并非妨碍高质量评估的主要障碍；但它并不能改变临床医生时间的供给，因为无论是远程还是面对面，同步问诊都会占用精神科医生整整一段时长。 然而，解决这一瓶颈并不意味着将精神科评估自动化，也不意味着取代精神科医生、社会工作者或接诊临床医生。 鉴于精神科护理的复杂性以及即使在模拟训练后仍观察到的高错误率，我们的研究结果并不支持将本系统进行自主部署；相反，任何近期前瞻性的临床角色都应严格限于辅助性质并由临床医生监督75；131；53，例如在就诊前开展结构化的预接诊，生成初步病史和症状摘要，供监督的临床医生在临床就诊过程中进行审阅、核实并在此基础上进一步工作，从而可能以结构化的系统医学回顾、用药情况核对以及对躯体疾病拟态疾病的初步鉴别筛查，来补充常规的心理社会接诊或静态问卷。

paragraphs.en: Several methodological and clinical limitations constrain what these results support. First, while multi-institutionally validated synthetic cases help address the scarcity of shareable psychiatric clinical data 75 and allowed training and automated evaluation to scale across the diagnostic taxonomy, simulated and clinician-enacted patients cannot reproduce the full range of rare conditions, backgrounds, motivations, or disorganized communication encountered in clinical practice; unlike trained professional standardized patients (such as those used in clinical trial rater calibration) or real patients, psychiatrists role-playing patients may present symptoms in overly structured, textbook patterns, making validation with professional standardized patients and real patient cohorts essential next steps. Second, our study uses a controlled within-model design comparing a lightweight policy model (Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite) against its identically prompted base checkpoint rather than against larger frontier models or human clinicians (such as psychiatrists or psychiatric social workers); while this design keeps multi-turn GRPO rollouts computationally tractable and isolates whether simulation training improves upon static prompt instructions, smaller model capacity likely constrained the ceiling on knowledge-intensive tasks such as comprehensive treatment planning (46.7% comprehensive and appropriate treatment in the OSCE), and future studies evaluating clinical readiness must incorporate human clinical comparators alongside ablations against non-interactive rubric fine-tuning and oracle-history baselines. Third, the training reward and scenario reference rubrics were generated within the same model family (Gemini 3.1 Pro) that served as the primary automated evaluator, introducing circularity risks including verbosity bias, stylistic mimicry, and reward hacking 203 ; 182 . Cross-evaluator validation with GPT-5.6-Luna confirmed that a substantial training gain persisted under an independent judge (difference between models 0.165, attenuated from 0.270 under the in-family Gemini evaluator against which the policy was trained), though agreement between language-model judges does not exclude shared stylistic preferences, underscoring why evaluation grounded in human clinical judgment remains essential. In the three-way concordance analysis (Section 2.2 ), only the in-family autorater was compared against psychiatrists on the OSCE transcripts.
paragraphs.zh: 若干方法学和临床方面的局限性限制了这些结果所能支持的范围。 首先，虽然经过多机构验证的合成病例有助于缓解可共享精神科临床数据稀缺的问题 75，并使训练与自动化评估得以在整个诊断分类体系上规模化，但模拟患者和由临床医生扮演的患者无法再现临床实践中遇到的各种罕见疾病、背景、动机或紊乱的交流方式；与受过训练的专业标准化患者（如临床试验评定者校准中所用的那些）或真实患者不同，由精神科医生扮演患者的表现可能过于结构化、过于教科书化，因此使用专业标准化患者和真实患者队列进行验证是必不可少的下一步。 其次，我们的研究采用受控的同模型内设计，将一个轻量级策略模型（Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite）与使用相同提示的其基础检查点进行比较，而非与更大的前沿模型或人类临床医生（如精神科医生或精神科社会工作者）进行比较；虽然这一设计使多轮 GRPO rollout 在计算上可行，并能分离出模拟训练是否优于静态提示指令，但较小的模型容量很可能限制了其在综合治疗方案等知识密集型任务上的上限（OSCE 中全面且适当的治疗为 46.7%），未来评估临床准备度的研究必须纳入人类临床对照，并同时进行与非交互式量规微调及完整病史（oracle-history）基线的消融比较。 第三，训练奖励和场景参考量规是由作为主要自动化评估器的同一模型家族（Gemini 3.1 Pro）生成的，这带来了循环性风险，包括冗长偏好、风格模仿和奖励作弊 203；182。 使用 GPT-5.6-Luna 进行的跨评估器验证证实，在独立评审下训练带来的显著增益仍然存在（两模型之间的差异为 0.165，较训练策略时所用同家族 Gemini 评估器下的 0.270 有所衰减），但语言模型评审之间的一致性并不能排除共同的风格偏好，这也凸显了以人类临床判断为依据的评估为何仍然不可或缺。 在三方一致性分析（第 2.2 节）中，只有同家族自动评估器在 OSCE 病例记录上与精神科医生进行了比较。

sents.en: Several methodological and clinical limitations constrain what these results support.
sents.zh: 若干方法学和临床方面的局限性限制了这些结果所能支持的范围。

sents.en: First, while multi-institutionally validated synthetic cases help address the scarcity of shareable psychiatric clinical data 75 and allowed training and automated evaluation to scale across the diagnostic taxonomy, simulated and clinician-enacted patients cannot reproduce the full range of rare conditions, backgrounds, motivations, or disorganized communication encountered in clinical practice; unlike trained professional standardized patients (such as those used in clinical trial rater calibration) or real patients, psychiatrists role-playing patients may present symptoms in overly structured, textbook patterns, making validation with professional standardized patients and real patient cohorts essential next steps.
sents.zh: 首先，虽然经过多机构验证的合成病例有助于缓解可共享精神科临床数据稀缺的问题 75，并使训练与自动化评估得以在整个诊断分类体系上规模化，但模拟患者和由临床医生扮演的患者无法再现临床实践中遇到的各种罕见疾病、背景、动机或紊乱的交流方式；与受过训练的专业标准化患者（如临床试验评定者校准中所用的那些）或真实患者不同，由精神科医生扮演患者的表现可能过于结构化、过于教科书化，因此使用专业标准化患者和真实患者队列进行验证是必不可少的下一步。

sents.en: Second, our study uses a controlled within-model design comparing a lightweight policy model (Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite) against its identically prompted base checkpoint rather than against larger frontier models or human clinicians (such as psychiatrists or psychiatric social workers); while this design keeps multi-turn GRPO rollouts computationally tractable and isolates whether simulation training improves upon static prompt instructions, smaller model capacity likely constrained the ceiling on knowledge-intensive tasks such as comprehensive treatment planning (46.7% comprehensive and appropriate treatment in the OSCE), and future studies evaluating clinical readiness must incorporate human clinical comparators alongside ablations against non-interactive rubric fine-tuning and oracle-history baselines.

sents.en: Third, the training reward and scenario reference rubrics were generated within the same model family (Gemini 3.1 Pro) that served as the primary automated evaluator, introducing circularity risks including verbosity bias, stylistic mimicry, and reward hacking 203 ; 182 .

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, because each OSCE transcript was graded by a single psychiatrist (with different evaluators across each pair), cross-rater reproducibility could not be estimated directly (Appendix A.6 ). Although transcript formatting and turn-count metadata were standardized and independent evaluators graded unpaired transcripts, the trained agent’s substantially longer consultations (median 60 vs. 8 clinician turns) could partially cue crossover clinician-patients during live interaction; however, independent psychiatrist score gains were not significantly correlated with turn-count differences across scenarios ( ρ = 0.18 \rho=0.18 [ − 0.09 -0.09 , 0.43 0.43 ]; Supplementary Fig. 1 c). The simulated and clinician-patient settings also used different interfaces (Methods, Section 4.4 ), and we did not separate patient from interface effects on interview length or score. The training gain nonetheless held under an OSCE interface that differed from the one used in training.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，由于每份 OSCE 转录仅由一名精神科医生评分（每对样本的评估者各不相同），无法直接估计评分者间的可重复性（附录 A.6）。 尽管转录格式与对话轮数等元数据已标准化，且独立评估者对未配对的转录进行评分，但训练后的智能体的问诊时长明显更长（中位数为 60 轮，而临床医生为 8 轮），这可能在现场交互过程中部分提示了交叉扮演的临床医生-患者；不过，独立精神科医生评分的提升与各场景间的对话轮数差异并无显著相关性（ρ = 0.18 [-0.09, 0.43]；补充图 1c）。 模拟环境与临床医生-患者环境还使用了不同的界面（方法，第 4.4 节），且我们未将患者因素与界面因素对访谈长度或评分的影响区分开来。 尽管如此，在与训练所用界面不同的 OSCE 界面下，训练带来的提升依然成立。

paragraphs.en: Clinically, our findings are restricted to single-encounter text-based intake rather than ongoing care. Single-encounter intake aims at a provisional formulation and triage plan, whereas ongoing psychiatric care, including longitudinal medication management and psychotherapy, requires sustained therapeutic relationships and adaptive treatment planning across repeated contact 180 ; 118 . Moreover, text restricts assessment to a text-inferable Mental Status Examination (Methods, Section 4.3 ); written dialogue exposes thought process, thought content, orientation, and expressed insight, but structurally excludes physical, behavioral, and non-verbal observations on which several diagnostic discriminations depend, including separating negative symptoms of schizophrenia from depressive psychomotor retardation, identifying catatonic features, and detecting acute intoxication or withdrawal 121 ; 84 . A text-based agent therefore cannot perform a comprehensive psychiatric examination or substitute for a psychiatrist, and at most could support preliminary, clinician-supervised pre-intake information gathering. In addition, all scenarios and consultations were conducted in English and the clinical norms encoded in our rubrics reflect US psychiatric practice, whereas linguistic expressions of distress, diagnostic conventions, emergency hold criteria, and duty-to-warn mandates vary across languages and jurisdictions 64 ; 49 , and the agent was trained for semi-structured intake as opposed to scripted diagnostic instruments such as the SCID-5 42 . Finally, deploying AI in psychiatric care raises domain-specific ethical risks 20 . Reinforcement learning to overcome guardedness corresponds in human practice to motivational interviewing 111 , but under unconstrained optimization has a potential risk of discovering manipulative conversational shortcuts, and individuals in distress are susceptible to anthropomorphic projection and parasocial attachment 87 . Any future translation would therefore require safeguards architecturally external to the learned policy, including hard output-level vetoes on clinical disposition and prescribing, anti-sycophancy auditing, clinician oversight, and deterministic escalation protocols for acute risk 154 .
paragraphs.zh: 在临床层面，我们的研究结果仅限于单次接触的文本式 intake，而非持续性诊疗。 单次接触式 intake 旨在形成初步的病情研判和分诊计划，而持续性精神科诊疗，包括纵向药物管理和心理治疗，则需要跨多次接触维持治疗关系并制定适应性治疗计划 180 ；118 。 此外，文本将评估限制在可由文本推断的精神状态检查（见方法，第 4.3 节）；书面对话可以揭示思维过程、思维内容、定向力和表达出的自知力，但在结构上排除了若干诊断鉴别所依赖的躯体、行为和非言语观察，包括区分精神分裂症的阴性症状与抑郁性精神运动性迟滞、识别紧张症特征，以及检测急性中毒或戒断 121 ；84 。 因此，基于文本的智能体无法进行全面的精神科检查，也无法替代精神科医生，最多只能支持由临床医生监督的 intake 前初步信息收集。 此外，所有场景和会诊均以英语进行，我们评分量表中编码的临床规范反映的是美国精神科执业惯例，而痛苦的语言表达、诊断惯例、紧急收治标准以及警示义务的强制性要求在不同语言和司法管辖区之间存在差异 64 ；49 ，且该智能体是为半结构化 intake 而训练的，并非针对 SCID-5 之类的脚本化诊断工具 42 。 最后，在精神科诊疗中部署人工智能会引发特定领域的伦理风险 20 。 通过强化学习来克服来访者的戒备心理，在人类实践中对应于动机式访谈 111 ，但在不受约束的优化下，存在发现操纵性对话捷径的潜在风险，而处于痛苦中的个体容易产生拟人化投射和准社会依恋 87 。 因此，任何未来的实际落地都需要在架构上独立于所学策略的保障措施，包括对临床处置和开药行为的硬性输出层否决、反谄媚审计、临床医生监督，以及针对急性风险的确定性升级协议 154 。

paragraphs.en: A simulation-trained agent conducted standardized psychiatric intake at a level that board-certified psychiatrists rated above its identically prompted base model across clinical examination skill, patient-centered communication, and diagnostic formulation. Standardized patient OSCEs are an established milestone in medical education, but they do not substitute for prospective validation in real patient populations; the environment, agent, reward functions, rubrics, and evaluation scenarios described here are research prototypes, and none has been cleared by any regulatory authority for clinical use. Prospective study under institutional clinician oversight, with real patients and longitudinal follow-up, is the necessary next step. Such text-based systems are not a substitute for psychiatric clinicians and are not ready for autonomous psychiatric assessment; the immediate clinical question for future research is whether, as strictly assistive tools operating under direct clinician oversight, they can help expand the reach of clinician-led care 191 ; 173 ; 75 . Answering that question requires the psychiatric community to define the evaluation standards and governance boundaries 75 ; 47 , and the evaluation framework, rubrics, and taxonomies described here are offered as one contribution toward that goal.
paragraphs.zh: 经仿真训练的智能体开展了标准化精神科接诊，其水平在美国专科委员会认证的精神科医生评分中，在临床检查技能、以患者为中心的沟通以及诊断思路构建方面均高于使用完全相同提示词的基础模型。 标准化病人客观结构化临床考试（OSCE）是医学教育中公认的里程碑，但它并不能替代在真实患者群体中进行的前瞻性验证；本文描述的环境、智能体、奖励函数、评分细则和评估场景均为研究原型，均未获得任何监管机构批准用于临床。 在机构临床医生监督下、面向真实患者并开展纵向随访的前瞻性研究，是必要的下一步。 这类基于文本的系统不能替代精神科临床医生，也尚未具备自主进行精神科评估的能力；未来研究面临的直接临床问题是：作为在临床医生直接监督下运行的严格辅助性工具，它们能否帮助扩大临床医生主导的诊疗的覆盖范围 191 ; 173 ; 75 。 要回答这一问题，需要精神医学界界定评估标准与治理边界 75 ; 47 ，本文所提供的评估框架、评分细则和分类体系，正是朝向这一目标的一项贡献。

sents.en: Such text-based systems are not a substitute for psychiatric clinicians and are not ready for autonomous psychiatric assessment; the immediate clinical question for future research is whether, as strictly assistive tools operating under direct clinician oversight, they can help expand the reach of clinician-led care 191 ; 173 ; 75 .
sents.zh: 这类基于文本的系统不能替代精神科临床医生，也尚未具备自主进行精神科评估的能力；未来研究面临的直接临床问题是：作为在临床医生直接监督下运行的严格辅助性工具，它们能否帮助扩大临床医生主导的诊疗的覆盖范围 191 ; 173 ; 75 。

sents.en: Answering that question requires the psychiatric community to define the evaluation standards and governance boundaries 75 ; 47 , and the evaluation framework, rubrics, and taxonomies described here are offered as one contribution toward that goal.
sents.zh: 要回答这一问题，需要精神医学界界定评估标准与治理边界 75 ; 47 ，本文所提供的评估框架、评分细则和分类体系，正是朝向这一目标的一项贡献。

paragraphs.en: Training an agent for psychiatric care requires a corpus that captures the diagnostic breadth, clinical ambiguity, and relational complexity of outpatient practice. A training set clustered on common presentations (such as uncomplicated depression or generalized anxiety) risks producing an agent that fails to generalize to diverse clinical encounters. Building on Liévin et al. Super , we developed a four-stage clinician-designed generation pipeline covering the diagnostic, demographic, and behavioral spectrum of outpatient psychiatry (Fig. 5 ). Of 50,000 initial generation requests, 48,243 scenarios passed quality verification and deduplication against the held-out evaluation scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 训练一个用于精神科诊疗的智能体，需要这样一个语料库：它能够涵盖门诊实践中的诊断广度、临床模糊性以及医患关系的复杂性。 若训练集仅围绕常见表现聚集（如无并发症的抑郁症或广泛性焦虑），则所训练的智能体可能无法泛化到多样化的临床场景。 在 Liévin 等人的基础上 Super，我们开发了一个由临床医生设计的四阶段生成流程，覆盖门诊精神医学的诊断、人口学和行为谱系（图 5）。 在 50,000 个初始生成请求中，有 48,243 个场景通过了质量校验，并经去重后与留出的评估场景进行了比对。

sents.en: Super , we developed a four-stage clinician-designed generation pipeline covering the diagnostic, demographic, and behavioral spectrum of outpatient psychiatry (Fig. 5 ).
sents.zh: Super，我们开发了一个由临床医生设计的四阶段生成流程，覆盖门诊精神医学的诊断、人口学和行为谱系（图 5）。

sents.zh: 在 50,000 个初始生成请求中，有 48,243 个场景通过了质量校验，并经去重后与留出的评估场景进行了比对。

paragraphs.en: The pipeline operates in four stages. First, a diagnostic domain and a presenting concern are sampled from a clinician-curated taxonomy grounded in standard psychiatric diagnostic classification (Stage 1). Second, a complete patient identity is constructed by sampling demographics, personality, and communicative behavior from population-calibrated distributions (Stage 2). Third, these clinician-defined specifications are assembled into a detailed, internally consistent clinical scenario using a language model as the generation engine (Stage 3). Fourth, a difficulty tier controls probabilistic augmentation of the scenario with additional clinical complexity, and automated quality checks filter for coherence, diversity, and information leakage (Stage 4).
paragraphs.zh: 该流程分为四个阶段运行。 首先，从基于标准精神科诊断分类、由临床医生精心整理的分类体系中，抽取一个诊断领域和一个主诉（阶段 1）。 其次，通过从经人群校准的分布中抽取人口统计学特征、人格与交流行为，构建完整的患者身份（阶段 2）。 第三，使用语言模型作为生成引擎，将这些由临床医生定义的规格组装成一个详细且内部一致的临床场景（阶段 3）。 第四，难度层级控制以概率方式为场景增加额外的临床复杂性，并通过自动化质量检查过滤连贯性、多样性与信息泄露问题（阶段 4）。

paragraphs.en: Scenarios are sampled across 15 clinical domains (mood and affect, anxiety and fear, trauma and stress-related, psychotic spectrum, substance use, OCD and related, cognitive and attention, sleep, eating and body image, self-harm and safety, interpersonal and behavioral, somatic and dissociative, neurodevelopmental, sexual and gender identity, and personality-related), each paired with domain-specific presenting concerns (see Appendix C.1.2 for an illustrative evaluation scenario package showing the clinical vignette and scoring rubric structure). The diagnostic domain is drawn from a 15-category distribution weighted by epidemiological prevalence data. Within the selected domain, a presenting concern and primary diagnosis are sampled jointly from condition-specific prevalence weights, ensuring the corpus reflects real-world diagnostic frequencies while maintaining representation of rare but clinically important conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 场景从 15 个临床领域（心境与情感、焦虑与恐惧、创伤与应激相关、精神病性谱系、物质使用、强迫及相关、认知与注意、睡眠、进食与身体意象、自我伤害与安全、人际与行为、躯体与解离、神经发育、性与性别认同、人格相关）中采样，每个领域均配有该领域特定的主诉（示例性的评估场景包——展示临床案例简介与评分量规结构——见附录 C.1.2）。 诊断领域从按流行病学患病率数据加权的 15 类分布中抽取。 在选定的领域内，主诉与主要诊断根据特定病症的患病率权重联合采样，确保语料库反映真实世界的诊断频率，同时保持对罕见但临床重要的病症的覆盖。

paragraphs.en: Each scenario receives a complete patient identity with demographics drawn from population-calibrated sources 117 ; 177 . Big Five personality traits (Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, Neuroticism; scored 0–100) are sampled from age- and sex-adjusted Gaussian distributions 165 ; 26 . A conversation effort score (1 to 5), derived primarily from the sampled Extraversion, Conscientiousness, and Neuroticism traits, governs response length and grammatical formality. Each scenario additionally receives a clinical presentation style (typical, atypical, somatic, subclinical, or mixed) and, with 50% probability, a challenging behavioral modifier (e.g., intellectualization, somatic communication style, poor insight) that shapes how the patient communicates distress.
paragraphs.zh: 每个场景都会获得一个完整的患者身份，其人口统计学特征取自经人群校准的数据来源 117 ; 177 。 大五人格特质（开放性、尽责性、外向性、宜人性、神经质；评分 0–100）从经年龄和性别调整的高斯分布中抽样 165 ; 26 。 对话努力评分（1 到 5）主要根据抽样得到的外向性、尽责性和神经质特质推导得出，用于控制回复长度和语法的正式程度。 每个场景还会额外获得一种临床表现风格（典型、非典型、躯体化、亚临床或混合），并以 50% 的概率获得一个挑战性行为修饰符（例如：理智化、躯体化沟通风格、缺乏自知力），该修饰符会影响智能体表达痛苦的方式。

paragraphs.en: Conditioned on the sampled diagnostic domain, presenting concern, and patient identity, a language model (Gemini 3.1 Pro 52 ) assembles the full clinical scenario according to a clinician-designed structured output schema. The schema enforces a comprehensive clinical specification that includes symptom progression, pertinent positives, and pertinent negatives informed by the DDxPlus evidence corpus 38 ; complete medical, psychiatric, family, social, and substance use histories; a ground-truth psychiatric diagnosis with all specifiers; treatment recommendations intended to be concordant with clinical practice guidelines; a cultural formulation (operationalized via the DSM-5 Cultural Formulation Interview; Appendix C.1.8 ); dynamic affect instructions using the Pleasure-Arousal-Dominance dimensional model 110 ; therapeutic responsiveness rules specifying how clinician communication quality modulates patient disclosure; and alliance rupture instructions specifying the type, trigger, and timing of mid-encounter therapeutic ruptures. Category-specific clinical guidance incorporates standard screening instruments (e.g., CAGE/AUDIT-C 37 ; 16 for substance use disorders; reality testing and medication adherence challenges for psychotic spectrum disorders). Half of all scenarios receive an additional structured skill challenge (e.g., diagnostic reformulation when new information contradicts the initial impression, risk stratification under ambiguity) to train adaptive reasoning under diagnostic uncertainty.
paragraphs.zh: 在给定的抽样的诊断领域、就诊主诉和患者身份条件下，一个语言模型（Gemini 3.1 Pro 52）根据临床医生设计的结构化输出模式（schema）组装完整的临床场景。 该模式强制执行一项全面的临床规范，其中包括：由 DDxPlus 证据语料库 38 提供依据的症状进展、相关阳性表现和相关阴性表现；完整的内科、精神科、家族、社会和物质使用病史；带有所有限定说明的金标准精神科诊断；旨在与临床实践指南保持一致的治疗建议；文化表述（通过 DSM-5 文化表述访谈操作化；附录 C.1.8）；使用愉悦-唤醒-支配（Pleasure-Arousal-Dominance）维度模型的动态情感指令；规定临床医生沟通质量如何调节患者自我披露的治疗响应性规则；以及规定诊疗过程中治疗联盟破裂的类型、触发因素和时机的联盟破裂指令。 针对特定类别的临床指导融入了标准化筛查工具（例如，用于物质使用障碍的 CAGE/AUDIT-C 37；16；用于精神病性谱系障碍的现实检验和服药依从性挑战）。 一半的场景会附加一个结构化的技能挑战（例如，当新信息与最初印象相矛盾时进行诊断重新表述，或在模糊条件下进行风险分层），以训练在诊断不确定性下的适应性推理。

paragraphs.en: Each scenario is assigned to one of four difficulty tiers (Easy, Medium, Hard, or Edge), favoring medium and hard cases. Each tier scales the probability of medical mimics and the activation rate across a library of 12 generative augmentation segments (short directive phrases, e.g., “the patient communicates distress through somatic complaints rather than emotional language”). Because segments activate independently and can stack, the effective augmentation space grows combinatorially with difficulty tier, producing layered clinical complexity across four categories (encounter context, patient narrative style, clinical challenge, and relational dynamics). For the 127 evaluation scenarios, tier assignment was subsequently audited by board-certified psychiatrists as one of the eight validation criteria (Section 4.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 每个场景被分配到四个难度层级之一（简单、中等、困难或边缘），并偏向中等和困难案例。 每个层级会在一个包含12个生成式增强片段的库中（即简短的指令性短语，例如“患者通过躯体化主诉而非情感化语言来表达痛苦”），按难度调整医学拟似情况出现的概率以及片段的激活率。 由于各片段独立激活且可以叠加，有效的增强空间随难度层级呈组合式增长，从而在四个类别（就诊情境、患者叙述风格、临床挑战和关系动态）中产生分层递进的临床复杂性。 对于127个评估场景，层级分配随后由委员会认证的精神科医生作为八项验证标准之一进行了审核（第4.6节）。

paragraphs.en: Generated scenarios undergo three automated quality checks: (1) clinical coherence verification rejecting scenarios with internally contradictory symptoms, diagnoses, or treatment plans; (2) a hidden-fact leakage check ensuring gated information is not revealed in opening statements; and (3) batch diversity analysis. Scenarios passing all checks are deduplicated using character n n -gram ( n ∈ [ 3 , 5 ] n\in[3,5] ) TF-IDF vectorization with a cosine similarity threshold τ dedup = 0.9 \tau_{\text{dedup}}=0.9 , including against the held-out evaluation scenarios. These checks are automated. Unlike the 127 clinician-validated intake evaluation scenarios (Section 4.6 ), the ground-truth diagnoses and treatment recommendations attached to the 48,243 training scenarios were generated by a language model and were not individually reviewed by clinicians; they should be treated as a synthetic training signal rather than as validated clinical standards.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的场景会经过三项自动化质量检查：(1) 临床一致性验证，拒绝内部症状、诊断或治疗方案相互矛盾的场景；(2) 隐含事实泄露检查，确保被门控的信息不会在开场陈述中透露；(3) 批次多样性分析。 通过所有检查的场景会使用字符 n n -gram（n∈[3,5] n\in[3,5]）TF-IDF 向量化进行去重，余弦相似度阈值为 τ dedup = 0.9 \tau_{\text{dedup}}=0.9，包括与留出的评估场景进行比对去重。 这些检查都是自动化的。 与经过 127 名临床医生验证的分诊评估场景（第 4.6 节）不同，附加在 48,243 个训练场景上的真实诊断和治疗建议是由语言模型生成的，并未经过临床医生逐一审核；它们应被视为合成训练信号，而非经过验证的临床标准。

paragraphs.en: To generate the multi-turn clinical encounters required for RL training, a patient simulator converts each static scenario specification (Section 4.1 ) into a conversational agent. The simulator conditions a language model (Gemini 3 Flash 50 ) on the complete clinical profile 𝒫 \mathcal{P} produced by the scenario pipeline, including the ground-truth psychiatric diagnosis, treatment history, and all psychiatric-specific fields. The simulator is used during training and to generate encounters on held-out scenarios for evaluation (Fig. 6 ).
